name: Cantharellus cibarius
notes: Medium-distance smooth type [13]. Reported (unchecked) to have very slow fruit bodies that last weeks and to need bacteria in culture; North American look-alikes are other species.

tip_speed.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): notoriously slow and hard to grow in culture; set at about a quarter of the family default

growth_unit.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): sparse mycelium in culture; guess

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found
